ChatGPT hidden characters: what they are and how to remove them

Pasted some text from an AI chat and found strange gaps, “oaicite” codes or tracking tags in your links? Here is where they come from and how to clean them in one click.

Updated 2026-11-07 · 5 min read
Clean your files in secondsFree, no sign-up, and everything runs in your browser — nothing is uploaded.
Open IA Cleaner

What can be hidden in copied AI text

  • Invisible Unicode characters: zero-width spaces (U+200B), word joiners (U+2060), byte-order marks (U+FEFF) and soft hyphens. They take up no space on screen but are still in the text.
  • Special spaces: no-break (U+00A0) and narrow no-break spaces (U+202F) that look like normal spaces.
  • Citation leftovers: when an answer cites sources, copying it into another app can leave markers such as contentReference[oaicite:0]{index=0} or 【4:0†source】.
  • Tracking parameters: links suggested by ChatGPT often end in ?utm_source=chatgpt.com.
  • Private-use characters: internal markers from the chat interface that show up as empty boxes in some apps.

Are they a watermark?

Mostly no. In 2025 users noticed that some newer models occasionally produced narrow no-break spaces, and many assumed it was a watermark; OpenAI said it was not intentional. Most hidden characters come from formatting and copy-paste. They are still worth removing: they can break code, search, word counts and formatting, and they reveal where the text was copied from.

Note that AI-text detectors judge the wording, not these characters — cleaning them won’t change what a detector thinks of your writing.

How to check and clean your text with IA Cleaner

  1. Open IA Cleaner → Text and paste your text.
  2. A live counter tells you how many hidden characters were found.
  3. Click Clean text. You’ll see every hidden character highlighted in place, with its Unicode code and name.
  4. Copy the clean result or download it as a .txt.

Compound emoji (👨‍👩‍👧) and flags are kept intact. An optional setting also converts curly quotes, em dashes and ellipses into plain characters.

Hidden messages in Unicode tags

A less common trick uses Unicode tag characters (U+E0000–E007F) to hide whole sentences inside normal-looking text — sometimes used for prompt injection. IA Cleaner decodes and shows any hidden message before removing it.

Cleaning text inside Word and PowerPoint files

If you already pasted AI text into a document, drop the .docx, .pptx or .xlsx into Images & documents: invisible characters are removed from the document text and its metadata is cleaned too.
